notes: Letter B filled 2026-08-19. Other letters stay unfilled. Schema updates must not pre-fill the next batch.

records.title: Bananas
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Ripeness changes starch versus sugar; vitamin B6 and potassium characterise the fruit; polyphenol oxidase matters in smoothies.
missing_research: Food-specific tryptophan quantity is not needed as an identity row; resistant starch remains a ripeness effect rather than a USDA row; green-banana microbiome trials are not cited on this page.
destined_for_substance_or_brs_matrix: Polyphenol oxidase smoothie pairing as preparation/strategy, not a Substances card.
Green-banana resistant starch effects on Bifidobacterium, Akkermansia, butyrate and gut barrier are study outcomes for the Food BRS Matrix, not the fruit’s primary role.
Tryptophan–serotonin pairing is mechanism/strategy, not ripe-banana identity.

records.title: Barley
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Cereal beta-glucan whole grain with lysine-limited protein that pairs with legumes.
destined_for_substance_or_brs_matrix: SCFA outcomes of beta-glucan fermentation belong on mechanism pages, not as barley substances.

records.title: Beef
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Complete protein with creatine, CoQ10 and highly absorbable heme iron; processing and cooking method change the health context.
destined_for_substance_or_brs_matrix: Generic neurotransmitter and mTOR reviews stay as context, not beef identity.

records.title: Beetroot
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Dietary nitrate vegetable with betalain pigments; folate belongs in the table.
missing_research: Food-specific beetroot nitrate quantity, and a beetroot cooking-loss paper if the Preparation line is later to carry a citation (not Schroeter cocoa).
A beetroot-specific betalain quantity is not required for the page to remain honest; keep the qualitative table row.
destined_for_substance_or_brs_matrix: Nitric oxide production is a mechanism outcome, not a beetroot substance.
Oral-bacteria nitrate conversion and vascular/mitochondrial claims stay off the food page until a beetroot-specific source exists.

records.title: Bell Peppers
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Very high vitamin C vegetable with carotenoids; useful with iron-containing plant meals.

records.title: Black Beans
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Lysine-rich legume; soaking and cooking change phytate and mineral availability. Recipe staple.

records.title: Black Goji
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Lycium ruthenicum berry kept for encyclopaedic coverage of anthocyanin-dense fruit; USDA black-plum panel withdrawn as the wrong species.
missing_research: Exact-food composition for Lycium ruthenicum (any matching national database or analytical paper).
destined_for_substance_or_brs_matrix: Anthocyanin biology belongs on substance pages once a matching composition source exists.

records.title: Black Pepper
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Culinary spice characterised by piperine; turmeric pairing is a meal synergy, not a pepper constituent.
missing_research: A food-specific piperine quantity if a defensible spice analysis is attached later.
destined_for_substance_or_brs_matrix: Curcumin bioavailability belongs on turmeric/curcumin pages.

records.title: Black Tea
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Oxidised tea beverage characterised by theaflavins and remaining catechins; unsweetened brew is low energy.
missing_research: Brewed-tea theaflavin/catechin quantities from a tea-specific composition source.

records.title: Blueberries
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Anthocyanin-rich berry with vitamin C and fibre in the table; blueberry feeding studies exist. Generic quercetin and antioxidant reviews on the page are context, not blueberry composition.
destined_for_substance_or_brs_matrix: Exercise/BDNF mechanism papers and generic quercetin reviews belong on substance or lifestyle pages.

records.title: Broccoli
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Crucifer providing glucoraphanin/sulforaphane potential plus folate and vitamin C in the table.
destined_for_substance_or_brs_matrix: Nrf2/glutathione mechanism detail belongs on sulforaphane pages.

records.title: Broccoli Sprouts
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Young sprouts concentrated in glucoraphanin with active myrosinase; food-safety handling matters. No USDA exact record; macros from the Norwegian table.
missing_research: A matching USDA or equivalent exact-sprout panel if one appears.

records.title: Brussels Sprouts
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Crucifer diversity with folate and vitamin C in the table; isothiocyanates are qualitative.
missing_research: A Brussels-specific isothiocyanate quantity is not required for the page to remain honest.
destined_for_substance_or_brs_matrix: Glutathione synthesis is a mechanism, not a Brussels substance.

records.title: Buckwheat
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Gluten-free pseudograin with magnesium and lysine-limited protein that pairs with legumes.
destined_for_substance_or_brs_matrix: Rutin/flavonoid detail can move to a substance page if admitted later.

records.title: Butter
records.distinctive_story_or_inclusion_reason: Culinary dairy fat with vitamin A and explicit 18:3 n-3; used in small portions. K2 remains qualitative.
